verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents its own key-authenticated GraphQL Developer API, including Framework Health and Vendor Data APIs and custom-integration push APIs, plus inbound webhook endpoints. Scripts and pipelines could use these to drive or feed the platform without the UI. Nothing in the evidence describes a CLI, a CI plugin or action, or a documented headless/CI workflow, so automation-in-CI is only implied through the API surface. Missing for 10: an official CLI or CI integration (e.g., GitHub Action or pipeline step), documented headless/CI usage guides, a downloadable API spec (OpenAPI probes returned 404), and hands-on corroboration of CI automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The Sprinto Developer API is built using GraphQL
Each webhook generates a unique endpoint URL that receives incoming requests from external services.
